gameplay: Side-scrolling run-and-gun western action.

descripcion_corta: Experience Sunset Riders on the Super Nintendo.

gameplay: Side-scrolling run-and-gun western (USA release).

descripcion_corta: Play the classic Sunset Riders on the SNES.

descripcion_corta: Experience Super Adventure Island for the SNES.

gameplay: First-person flight combat simulator.

gameplay: First-person flight combat sequel with improved graphics.

gameplay: Realistic baseball simulation with detailed animation.

gameplay: Enhanced baseball simulation with updated graphics.
